episodes.title: Mercenaire du prêt-à-porter
episodes.summary: Karl Lagerfeld meets Jacques de Bascher and takes the reins of French fashion house Chloé.

episodes.title: Avez-vous un style ?
episodes.summary: While Karl works for the iconic Marlene Dietrich, Jacques gets dangerously close to Yves.

episodes.title: In Bed with Karl
episodes.summary: Karl declares war on Chloé and presses Jacques to choose between him and Yves.

episodes.title: La mauvaise réputation
episodes.summary: While Karl confronts Yves and Pierre, Jacques flees Paris.

episodes.title: Le mariage du siècle
episodes.summary: Karl wants to scream his success from the rooftops. But for that, he needs Jacques by his side.

episodes.title: Monaco ?
episodes.summary: A new fashion wave is here. Karl must choose between Jacques and his all-consuming ambition.
